title: Microplastics may be changing the colour of the Pacific Ocean
summary_full: Research indicates that microplastics in the Great Pacific Garbage Patch may be changing ocean color. This change creates a subtle blue-green tint that satellites have detected over twenty years. Scientists analyzed how microplastics affect light scattering and absorption and compared it with natural materials. Future studies will require optical measurements from the patch for confirmation. Preventing microplastics from entering oceans is critical to reducing their impact.
